features.title: Program roadmap and machine-readable feature catalog
features.outcome: A fresh session can select one bounded feature with explicit dependencies, gates, artifacts, and acceptance criteria.

acceptance.requirement: Both JSON artifacts parse and the catalog satisfies feature.schema.json.
Feature identifiers are unique, all dependencies resolve, and the dependency graph is acyclic.
The human-readable roadmap and machine-readable feature order agree.
No runtime code, prompt, model call, or paid work is introduced.

features.title: Architecture record and normative service specification
features.outcome: A ratified architecture record explains the selected boundary and a normative specification defines conformance without implementing the controller.

acceptance.requirement: Process, trust, storage, episode, verification, approval, and recovery boundaries are explicit.
Every normative MUST maps to a feature and a planned conformance test.
Safe retry and unknown-side-effect behavior are specified with no unresolved priority-zero trust decision.
No runtime implementation or production prompt is added.

features.title: Deterministic control kernel
features.outcome: Typed code owns workflow truth through validated transitions, durable snapshots, append-only events, locking, and a fake runner.

acceptance.requirement: Allowed and forbidden transitions are exhaustively unit-tested.
Injected crashes recover the same state without duplicating completed side effects.
Forged approvals, invalid events, and concurrent writers are refused.
All acceptance uses fake time, repository, and agent runner with zero model calls.

features.title: Repository observer and deterministic handoff renderer
features.outcome: Git and command observations replace model claims about repository state and render a deterministic handoff preview.

acceptance.requirement: Branch, base commit, dirty state, changed paths, and scope are computed rather than model-authored.
Identical trusted state renders byte-identical status and handoff previews.
Out-of-scope edits and unexpected repository divergence stop execution.
Manual HANDOFF.md remains authoritative pending the EL-07 migration verdict.

features.title: Prompt compiler and prompt contracts
features.outcome: Role-specific prompt packets are compiled from invariant hypershot frames and typed task data under explicit context budgets.

acceptance.requirement: All prompt and meta-prompt artifacts follow the attached Prompt-Engineering and Hypershot protocols.
Invariant frames and concrete task data occupy separate layers and no reusable template contains a task-specific concrete example.
Prompt bytes are normalized, versioned, hashed, budgeted, and snapshot-pinned.
Planner, implementer, checker, and recovery outputs cross strict schemas.

features.title: Codex app-server runner and episode rotation
features.outcome: The controller can start, observe, interrupt, and resume bounded Codex episodes without treating conversation history as workflow truth.

acceptance.requirement: Protocol fixtures cover start, resume, interrupt, timeout, failure, and controller restart.
Thread continuation is limited to one episode and semantic boundaries create fresh threads.
The runner cannot advance protected controller state directly.
Real integration smoke testing requires no paid model completion.

features.title: Verification, protected gates, recovery, and checker
features.outcome: Only independent evidence and explicit authority can advance implementation toward completion.

acceptance.requirement: Model reports cannot fabricate passing commands, approval records, or protected transitions.
Paid, destructive, push, merge, and acceptance-change gates withstand adversarial fixtures.
Only typed transient failures retry automatically and all retries are bounded.
Unknown external side-effect outcomes stop and the independent checker is read-only.

features.title: Bounded pilot, repeated evaluation, and handoff migration verdict
features.outcome: Measured evidence determines whether the controller replaces the manual session workflow.

acceptance.requirement: Isolated repeated trials report context, time, cost, intervention, stale-state, and acceptance-reliability measurements.
Failure transcripts are reviewed for agent, grader, environment, and harness error.
Protected-gate adversarial tests remain perfect and no acceptance reliability regression is observed.
The owner records an adopt, revise, or reject verdict before HANDOFF.md authority changes.

features.title: Optional scheduling and scale expansion
features.outcome: Evidence determines whether tracker polling, scheduling, concurrency, multi-machine durability, or extraction into a standalone project is justified.

acceptance.requirement: A new owner-approved proposal identifies a measured limitation of the single-controller implementation.

features.title: Optional verified ingestion of completed run reports
features.outcome: Sanitized completed-run evidence may enter Trellis for retrospective research without becoming part of the live control path.

acceptance.requirement: A new owner-approved design specifies sanitization, source bytes, provenance, retention, and the prohibition on circular control dependencies.

features.title: Controller activation and status-authority migration
features.outcome: The controller runs as a real process, owns mutable status in protected state, and the catalog retains immutable feature definitions only.

acceptance.requirement: A real non-test entrypoint resolves a protected state root outside the assigned worktree and refuses contained, aliased, and symlink-reachable roots.

Seeding succeeds only with owner approval material read from the protected external channel and atomically consumed; it is refused without approval, with forged or replayed approval, and against non-empty acceptance state.
The catalog carries no mutable status, statusAuthority is protected_controller_state, every status read resolves from protected state, and a test asserts the exact authority value.
With status resolved from the acceptance ledger, the derived report, status view, and handoff preview render deterministically and resolve next_feature to EL-10.

The acceptance ledger is append-only, monotonically sequenced, and integrity-linked; missing sequences, digest mismatch, and partial appends stop resolution and route to a recovery ceremony with no silent repair.

Both recovery ceremonies exist and their predicates are disjoint: content corruption on a validating chain recovers by owner-approved append-superseding, and integrity-chain corruption recovers only by out-of-band re-genesis retaining the corrupt generation read-only.
